Scientists are still unraveling neutrinos—ghostly particles that pass straight through your body by the trillions every second. What if neutrinos suddenly interacted with matter like light does? Right now, Earth is virtually transparent to them, letting solar neutrinos pass through the entire globe completely unnoticed. If they began colliding with atoms, night would instantly vanish, as radiation poured upward directly through the ground from beneath your feet. Deep underground bunkers couldn't hide you. Would life survive with nowhere to hide? Follow for more what-ifs.

Based on today's news: Neutrinos Are Everywhere. Now What? - The New York Times
